basic_details.job_title: College of Engineering Chengannur Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for Tradesman, Demonstrator and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: College of Engineering Chengannur will hold a walk-in interview on 5 November 2026 at 10.00 am, before the Principal, College of Engineering Chengannur, Chengannur, Alappuzha - 689 121, Kerala. The college, under the Institute of Human Resources Development (IHRD), Government of Kerala, is making temporary appointments for vacancies of the 2026-27 academic year in three posts: Demonstrator/Workshop Instructor (Computer), Tradesman (Computer) and Computer Programmer. A rank list will be prepared from the interview.

age_limit.details: The notice states that the age limit will be as per Government norms. It does not print a numeric limit or a cut-off date. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: 3-year Diploma in Computer (First Class) / First Class degree in BSc Computer Science
First Class in PGDCA / First Class degree in BSc Computer Science

qualification.details: The notice gives one qualification line for each post. All three posts have their walk-in on the same day and at the same time. | A 3-year Diploma in Computer with First Class, OR A First Class degree in BSc Computer Science. | SSLC and NTC in Computer (both are needed). | First Class in PGDCA, OR A First Class degree in BSc Computer Science. | The notice states that the age limit will be as per Government norms. It does not print a numeric limit or a cut-off date. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

important_instructions: Candidates must appear in person on the specified date and at the specified time. The appointments are temporary, against vacancies that have arisen for the 2026-27 academic year. For details, the notice gives the website https://ceconline.edu and the phone number 0479 2454125. The college letterhead also gives Ph: +91 479 2454125, 8547005032 and the email addresses [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.question: Q1. When is the CEC Chengannur walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for all three posts is on 5 November 2026 at 10.00 am.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the CEC Chengannur walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: Candidates must appear in person before the Principal, College of Engineering Chengannur, Chengannur, Alappuzha - 689 121, Kerala.

faq.question: Q3. Which posts are filled through this walk-in?
faq.answer: The posts are Demonstrator/Workshop Instructor (Computer), Tradesman (Computer) and Computer Programmer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Demonstrator/Workshop Instructor (Computer)?
faq.answer: A 3-year Diploma in Computer with First Class, or a First Class degree in BSc Computer Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Tradesman (Computer)?
faq.answer: Candidates need SSLC and NTC in Computer.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Computer Programmer?
faq.answer: First Class in PGDCA, or a First Class degree in BSc Computer Science.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice states that the age limit will be as per Government norms.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should candidates bring?
faq.answer: Original certificates proving qualification and age, along with attested copies of them.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Through an interview, from which a rank list will be prepared.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice is for temporary appointments against vacancies of the 2026-27 academic year.
